steps.title: Define requirements for Gemini Chat Pro
steps.description: Analyze the core architectural details including round-robin Gemini API key rotation, multi-language TextToSpeech engine, custom styling, and lightweight native components.

steps.title: Configure app/build.gradle script
steps.description: Configure compile and target SDK versions to 34, enforce JVM 1.8 compatibility, and remove all external library dependencies to preserve native light weight.

steps.title: Configure AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Add network permissions and declare MainActivity with Theme.Material.Light support.

steps.title: Generate custom drawable shape backgrounds
steps.description: Build bubble-style backgrounds for both user messages and AI responses with asymmetric corner radii using XML shape structures.

steps.title: Generate vector icons for layout widgets
steps.description: Construct vector graphic files representing speak, mute, send, and individual bubble speak triggers.

steps.title: Create main application activity layout
steps.description: Design high-fidelity UI including a modern header bar, API rotation status monitor, active key management buttons, ListView, and message input tray.

steps.title: Create chat bubble list item layout
steps.description: Construct custom item_chat.xml managing side-by-side visibility toggle structures for user bubbles and AI bubbles.

steps.title: Implement Message model class
steps.description: Write data structures holding text content, timestamp, and metadata variables to distinguish speech and role classifications.

steps.title: Implement custom BaseAdapter
steps.description: Write ChatAdapter.java supporting high performance ListView item rendering and dynamic trigger callback triggers for voice readout buttons.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity logic
steps.description: Incorporate HttpURLConnection-based round-robin rotation of 40 keys, native multi-locale offline TTS, and runtime interactive key updating tools.

steps.title: Building Gemini Chat Pro
steps.description: Trigger standard gradle assemble debug compiler instructions to construct and verify the resulting debug package.
